The multiply-spread trick is verified equivalent: (qh_field * 0x02040810) & 0x10101010 places field bits 0-3 at positions 4/12/20/28, identical to the original four shift/mask/or steps, and the four partial products (bit ranges 4-7, 11-14, 18-21, 25-28) are disjoint for any 4-bit field, so no carries reach the masked bits. The qh1 path reads bits 16-19 of vh[i], matching the original upper-nibble mapping. The wrapper hoist preserves vh[i] semantics exactly; the signed-to-unsigned shift change is immaterial because only masked bit positions <= 31 are read at the maximum shift of 12 (iqs+i <= 3). Mixed int/uint32_t OR cannot set bit 31 (max 0x1F1F1F1F), so no signedness hazard. Governance: only ggml/src/ggml-cuda/vecdotq.cuh and the two declared symbols (vec_dot_q5_0_q8_1, vec_dot_q5_0_q8_1_impl) are touched, both within cuda-vecdotq-v1 authority; change class arithmetic is permitted; no launch-geometry or wave-count mutation, so the dnr-q5-four-wave record and the hypothesis stop rules are respected, and no DNR fingerprint matches this mechanism. Performance mechanism is plausible: roughly twelve dependent shift/and/or VALU ops per unroll iteration are replaced by and + v_mul_lo_u32 + and + or; even at quarter-rate for the multiply this shortens the dependency chain feeding each dp4a. Risk that the memory-bound kernel shows no exact-duration gain is real but is precisely what the declared falsifier and the 0.5%/0.125% nomination/replication floors will adjudicate.
